description:
§17.1.1 — an element carrying `else-if=` immediately after a plain `

` fires E-CTRL-002. The condition is parenthesized (§5.2). The `` + `let ` twin of ctrl-002-orphan-else-if-pos (legacy rhs-decl shape), so the bootstrap grades it. Severity (Error) is pinned by that legacy-shape twin; it is not asserted here because a bootstrap Diag carries no §34 severity yet.
rationale: §17.1.1 Normative Rules: "An element carrying `else-if=` SHALL be immediately preceded at the same parent level by an element carrying `if=` or `else-if=`. The compiler SHALL reject any `else-if=` attribute that does not satisfy this condition (E-CTRL-002)."
